summary: Require an explicit heading boundary before assigning an RFI question or response role.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Confirmed synthetic reproduction where Request for Information became QUESTION and Response time plus Questionnaire became MIXED
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy improvements.
known_limitations: Only standalone role headings or headings with the existing colon, hash or dash separator are recognized.
Semantic question/response inference remains a human review task.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model, external provider or customer file was used.
